verify.test: bash -c 'cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" || exit 1; bad=$( { for f in .claude-plugin/marketplace.json docs/shared-lines-allowlist.txt skill/work-pr/SKILL.md skill/work-issue/SKILL.md CLAUDE.md; do [ -f "$f" ] || echo "MISSING INPUT $f"; done; jq empty $(git ls-files "*.json") || echo "INVALID JSON"; jq -r ".plugins[] | (.skills // [])[]" .claude-plugin/marketplace.json | sort -u | while read -r p; do [ -f "$p/SKILL.md" ] || echo "BAD SKILL $p"; done; jq -r ".plugins[] | (.commands // [])[]" .claude-plugin/marketplace.json | sort -u | while read -r p; do case "$p" in *.md) [ -f "$p" ] || echo "MISSING COMMAND $p";; *) echo "NO .md EXTENSION $p";; esac; done; grep -Fxf skill/work-pr/SKILL.md skill/work-issue/SKILL.md | awk "length > 60" | grep -vFxf docs/shared-lines-allowlist.txt | sed "s/^/DUPLICATED /"; BT=$(printf "\140"); TAB=$(printf "\t"); jq -r ".plugins[] | select(.description | endswith(\".\")) | \"DESC TERMINAL PERIOD \\(.name)\"" .claude-plugin/marketplace.json; NAMES=$(jq -r ".plugins[].name" .claude-plugin/marketplace.json); jq -r ".plugins[] | \"\\(.name)\t\\(.description)\"" .claude-plugin/marketplace.json | while IFS="$TAB" read -r name desc; do line=$(awk -v h="### $BT$name$BT" "p { print; exit } \$0 == h { p = 1 }" CLAUDE.md); [ -n "$line" ] || { echo "DESC NO HEADING $name"; continue; }; [ "$line" = "$desc." ] || echo "DESC DRIFT $name"; done; grep -oE "^### $BT[^$BT]+$BT" CLAUDE.md | tr -d "#$BT " | while read -r h; do echo "$NAMES" | grep -qxF "$h" || echo "DESC NO PLUGIN $h"; done; } 2>&1 ); [ -z "$bad" ] && echo "structural checks pass" || { echo "$bad"; exit 1; }'
